new_value: The project comprises of 7 Residential Towers (T03, T07, T08, T10, T11, T14, T15) part of overall 65 acre Mixed Use Development located on Bellary Road, Byatarayanapura, Bangalore, India and comprises of IT SEZ / Commercial Offices, Retail, Residential, Clubhouse, etc., The intent is to create a masterpiece in residential living integrated with Offices which will be a lifestyle destination in achieving “Walk to Work” concept. Along with this the endeavour is to create a fully sufficient, sustainable, self-contained gated and secure township with local retail, public/semi-public amenities, parks & open spaces, strong urban streets, utilities etc. A place which will have unique themed gardens/landscapes with unique features like putting green as mini golf course practice, tennis courts, cycling/skating track, etc. Various infrastructure facilities like roads, power, water management system, reticulated gas supply system, waste management system (solid & sewage), high-tech optical fibre connectivity are expected to be seamlessly integrated into the Mixed Use Development. The theme is to create Gated Community Neighborhood catering to the middle income & high income groups with integrated Work Place which will be path breaking or futuristic in development, reflecting L&T's values towards environment and sustainability. The development should be a destination which people would desire or yearn to belong to and should be proud to behold.
